plot: On Halloween night in the garden a towel scarecrow grabs Pim and demands three riddles or Pim becomes pumpkin stuffing; Lolly and Zeek crack two while Bup's shark answer nearly seals the lid, Crispy notices the scarecrow buzzes and that the third riddle describes a mixer, Lolly unmasks Whisker the hand mixer working the empty scarecrow like a puppet, Crispy pulls his plug, and the cord turns out to run up the drainpipe to the roof.

script.title: Answer 3 Riddles or Pim Becomes Pumpkin Stuffing

beats.say: HELP! The scarecrow grabbed my bandage! He's dragging me in!
Ssshhh... Three riddles. Get one wrong, and he becomes my stuffing.
Three riddles? Can we really win Pim back with riddles?
Okay team, nobody panic. Lolly, you love riddles. You're up.
I do love riddles! I'm the riddle queen of Table Land!
Then queen faster, please! It smells like old pumpkin in here!
Listen. Every time he talks... something buzzes.
Straw doesn't buzz. Towels don't buzz. Fascinating. Deeply suspicious.
Riddle one! What gets wetter, the more that it dries?
A sponge? A puddle? M-m-my tears? I'm crying a lot right now!
A towel! The answer is a towel. Like you, Mister Stuffing!
Correct... Lucky little star.
Pumpkin seeds spray out of his head like a sprinkler.
One down! See? Easy. We'll be home by snack time.
Riddle two! What has many teeth, but never bites?
Easy. A shark... with really, really good manners!
Guys! The lid is closing! I can see the stuffing! It's itchy!
One more wrong answer and Pim stays in there forever!
Sorry! Sharks were the only thing with teeth I could think of!
A comb! Many teeth, zero bites. It's a comb. Obviously.
Hmm. Correct. But nobody, nobody has ever solved my third riddle.
There it is again. That buzz comes from inside his head.
And it gets louder right before he speaks. Like an engine.
Riddle three! I whip. I whirl. I spin all day.
I sleep in a drawer. Now tell me... who am I?
A spinning top? A tornado? A very, very dizzy spoon?
Last chance, star! Wrong answer and the pumpkin closes FOREVER!
Lolly, no pressure, but please be right! Please, please, please!
Wait. Buzzing. Spinning. Seeds flying everywhere. Lolly... it's not a riddle.
He's describing himself. Whoever is hiding inside that pumpkin head.
Then the answer is... a MIXER! The mixer inside your head!
Hee hee hee! You found me! Let's MIX it up!
Out pops Whisker, the hand mixer. The scarecrow flops down, completely empty.
The scarecrow was never alive. It was a puppet on beaters!
I spin him, he talks, you scream! Best game ever! Hee hee!
You used my favorite game... to trick me?
NOBODY CHEATS AT RIDDLES IN MY GARDEN!
Eep! The cookie is scary! Spin faster, spin faster!
Careful, Lolly! Angry Lolly breaks things. Mostly us!
Catch me if you can! I'm the fastest thing in this garden!
Mixers need power. I'll follow the cord.
Crispy rolls along the white cord, past the pumpkins, to the plug.
Game over.
Hee... hee... heeeee...
The pumpkin lid pops open. Pim tumbles out, covered in towel fluff.
I was going to say mixer. I had fluff in my mouth.
Sure you were, Pim. Nice work, riddle queen.
Wait. This cord was never plugged into the wall.
It runs up the drainpipe... all the way to the roof.
